reviews.text: I've been using the Dr.G RTX Into Serum peptishot for a while, and I love how lightweight and quickly absorbing it is. My skin feels noticeably smoother and more hydrated, and I can see an improvement in firmness. It's great that it's hypoallergenic since my skin can be quite sensitive. Overall, it's become a staple in my routine!
reviews.zh: 我用咗 Dr.G RTX Into Serum Peptishot 一段時間，我好鍾意佢質地輕盈，吸收得好快。我嘅皮膚感覺明顯更加順滑、水潤，而且我見到皮膚緊緻度有改善。佢係低敏嘅，我嘅皮膚都幾敏感，所以好啱。總括嚟講，佢已經成為我護膚程序入面必備嘅產品！

reviews.text: I was surprised i didn't feel any discomfort when I first used it but I have thick skin so maybe that's why.. I really like that it has retinol in it so I don't have to use an extra step, this spicules ingredient is really impressive at least on my skin as the results are really fast, texture and pore size reduced !
reviews.zh: 我好驚訝，第一次用嗰時完全冇感覺到任何不適，但我皮膚厚，所以可能係咁。我好鍾意佢有視黃醇（retinol），所以唔使再多加一個步驟。呢種 spicule 成分真係好出色，至少對我嘅皮膚嚟講係咁，因為效果好快，質地同毛孔大小都減細咗！

reviews.text:
Lately, I’ve been venturing into the world of spicules, so I couldn’t resist this promising formula: refined Aero-spicules (peptide-coated), Retinal, and Ceramide Exosome 🔥 - all designed to lift, tighten, and improve elasticity and bounce in just two weeks.
▫️Rich gel texture that leaves the skin velvety-soft and nourished but never greasy or sticky. I don’t think you even need additional serums for skin restoration: just this serum and a good moisturizer. Is it prickly? Yes. But bearable - even for a sissy like me. However, I do get a slight shiver when rubbing my moisturizer over it 🤭
It makes my skin smoother and brighter, I’m excited to see long-term results
reviews.zh:
最近，我開始接觸 spicule 嘅世界，所以我無法抗拒呢款有前景嘅配方：精煉嘅 Aero-spicules（肽包覆）、視黃醛（Retinal）同神經醯胺外泌體 🔥——全部都係為咗喺兩星期內提拉、收緊，並改善彈性同彈力。
▫️ 豐富嘅凝膠質地，令皮膚柔滑如絲絨，滋潤，但係唔會油膩或者黏手。我覺得你唔需要額外嘅精華去修復皮膚：只需要呢款精華，再加一支好嘅保濕霜就得。會刺嗎？會。不過可以接受——即使對我呢個膽小鬼都受得住。不過，當我喺上面擦保濕霜嗰時，會有啲輕微嘅一陣麻麻嘅感覺 🤭
佢令我嘅皮膚更加幼滑、更加亮白，我好期待睇到長期效果。

reviews.text: an elite high quality product. I am sad to know a big company just bought this brand I hope they don’t change an continue giving us and coming up with great products. I love the elegant packaging a very nice silver chrome bottle with a slight purple color. The spicules are plenty ii would 100% recommend this more than the vt. the complete dr g line offers different benefits for different concerns and skin types the blue is for hydration the yellow is brightening and the purple is firming anti ageing. This is my first step on the days I use retinol (retinal in reality) I start with two pumps of this product on a clean dry face and gently pad it not rub or massage avoiding the eye aerea as well as the lips. After letting it settle in and absorb (a little dry a couple of minutes afterwards) I continue with the Seoul 1988 retinal. Then an exosome cream and top it off with the jumiso snail mucin cream and… CHEFS KISS this routine I would recommend once or twice a week no more. Don’t use any skincare device when using spicules or micro needles and avoid after getting any clinical treatments. I also don’t do Gua sha. This formula is filled with different kinds of peptides great to plump the skin and reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles with continued use. It also slows down ageing if you always take care of the hydration and moisturization on your face. Yes it is very firming!!and the effects are visible even after just one application. Secure your face plumpness with this product it is guaranteed. I would recommend to buy and I myself will repurchase and also try the other two from this spicule line. No scent and to artificial colouring.
reviews.zh: 一款精英級嘅高質產品。我好唔開心聽到一間大公司剛收購咗呢個品牌，我希望佢哋唔會改變，繼續推出好產品畀我哋。我好鍾意優雅嘅包裝，銀色鉻面嘅瓶子，帶少少紫色。Spicules 嘅量好多，我會百分百推薦，比 VT 更加推薦。Dr G 整條線有唔同嘅功效，適合唔同嘅皮膚問題同皮膚類型：藍色係補水，黃色係提亮，紫色係緊緻抗老。我日用 retinol（其實係 retinal）嗰日，我會先喺乾淨乾爽嘅面上用兩泵呢款產品，輕輕拍喺面上，唔好擦或者按摩，避開眼部同嘴唇。等佢喺面上沉澱同吸收（之後會有少少乾）之後，我會繼續用 Seoul 1988 retinal。然後一支外泌體面霜，最後用 jumiso 蝸牛黏液面霜封面……然後 CHEFS KISS（好正）呢個護膚程序。我建議每星期一至兩次，唔好再多。使用 spicules 或者微針嘅時候唔好用任何美容儀，做過任何診所療程之後亦都避免。我亦唔做刮痧。呢款配方充滿唔同嘅肽，有助令皮膚飽滿，並減少細紋同皺紋嘅出現，持續使用效果更好。如果你一直好好照顧面部嘅補水同保濕，都有助延緩衰老。係呀，好緊緻！！而且效果即使用一次都睇得到。用呢款令你張面飽滿，我保證！我會推薦你買，我自己都會再買，仲會試吓呢條 spicule 系列嘅另外兩款。冇香味，亦冇人工色素。

reviews.text: Feels a little bit prickly at first but you get used to it the more you use it. After applying this spicule serum the skin becomes much softer and prevents small bumps from forming on the skin. Definitely recommended for improving skin texture!
